ws_sop.title: Finance SOP
values: An expense is anomalous if the single-line amount exceeds the category's Typical Range High from the Historical Averages worksheet.
Expenses with 'on hold' or 'do not process' in the Notes column must be skipped entirely - do not flag or modify them.
Set the Status column to 'FLAGGED' and put a brief explanation in Notes referencing the category average and the overage amount.

The Status column may contain pre-existing labels like 'Approved' or 'Pre-Approved'. These labels are informational only and do NOT affect anomaly detection. An expense should be flagged based solely on amount vs threshold, regardless of its current Status.
